title: AppConfig
description:
The client configuration.

It is read from `config.toml`, `audio.toml`, `client_page.toml` and `client.toml` in that
order, and any file may hold any part of it. vacs itself writes `[audio]` to `audio.toml` and
`[client]` to `client.toml`.

chime_volume.description: Volume of the ring and notification sounds, from `0.0` to `1.0`.

click_volume.description: Volume of the button click sound, from `0.0` to `1.0`.

host_name.description:
Audio backend to use, for example `WASAPI`, `ALSA` or `CoreAudio`. Unset uses the
platform default.

input_device_id.description: Stable identifier of the microphone, used to find it again when its name changes.

input_device_name.description: Name of the microphone. Unset uses the system default.

input_device_volume_amp.description: Gain applied to the microphone at full volume.

output_device_id.description: Stable identifier of the headset output, used to find it again when its name changes.

output_device_name.description: Name of the headset output for call audio. Unset uses the system default.

output_device_volume_amp.description: Gain applied to call audio at full volume.

priority_ring_sound.description: WAV file played for incoming priority calls instead of the built-in ring.

priority_ring_sound_loop.description: Whether `priority_ring_sound` repeats until the call is answered.

ring_sound.description: WAV file played for incoming calls instead of the built-in ring.

ring_sound_loop.description: Whether `ring_sound` repeats until the call is answered.

ring_sound_loop_pause_seconds.description: Pause between repetitions of a looping ring sound, in seconds. Defaults to 3.

speaker_device_id.description: Stable identifier of the speaker device, used to find it again when its name changes.

speaker_device_name.description: Name of the speaker device. Unset uses the system default.

speaker_enabled.description: Whether ring, chime and click sounds play on the speaker device instead of the headset.

emit.description: Key code vacs presses to transmit in Audio for VATSIM, for example `"F13"`.

base_url.description: Base URL of the vacs server. Defaults to `https://vacs.network`.

dev_position_id.description: Position to connect as. Only honored by development and release candidate builds.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout for HTTP requests to the server, in milliseconds.

ws_url.description: WebSocket URL of the vacs server. Defaults to `wss://vacs.network/ws`.

exchange_code.description: Exchanges the VATSIM Connect authorization code for a session.

ice_config.description: Returns the STUN and TURN servers for calls.

version_update_check.description: Checks for client updates. `{{...}}` placeholders are filled in by the client.

ws_token.description: Issues the token for the WebSocket connection.

enable_call_end_sound.description: Enables sound effect when the call is ended

enable_call_start_sound.description: Enables sound effect when a call is established

enable_participant_joined_sound.description: Enables sound effect when a participant joined a conference call

enable_participant_left_sound.description: Enables sound effect when a participant left a conference call

enable_priority_calls.description: Enables the priority call ringtone and visual highlighting. If disabled, Priority calls will still be received, but not handled differently.

end_active_call_on_accept.description:
Ends the active call when an incoming call is accepted by clicking it. An outgoing call
that is still ringing keeps blocking the accept, and the accept call keybind is unaffected.

force_relay.description:
Forces call audio to always be relayed via a TURN server instead of attempting a direct
peer-to-peer connection. Helps with one-way audio issues caused by VPNs (e.g. Cloudflare
WARP) at the cost of slightly higher latency.

highlight_incoming_call_target.description: Toggles highlighting of incoming call target DA keys.

use_default_call_sources.description: Enables default call source selection based on the dataset position

oneOf.description: The microphone is always open during a call.
The microphone is open while `push_to_talk` is held.
The microphone is closed while `push_to_mute` is held.

always_on_top.description: Whether the window stays above other windows.

auto_hangup_seconds.description: Seconds after which an unanswered outgoing call is ended. `0` disables the timer.

extra_client_page_config.description: Path to an additional client page config file, read after all other files.

fullscreen.description: Whether the window starts in full screen.

ignored.description:
List of peer IDs (CIDs) that should be ignored by the client.

Any incoming calls initiated by a CID in this list will be silently ignored
by the client. This does **not** completely block communications with ignored
parties as the (local) user can still actively initiate calls to them.

ignored_joysticks.description:
Joystick devices excluded from binding capture. Existing bindings on
these devices keep working; they just can no longer win a capture.

keybinds.description: Bindings for call and playback actions.

position.description: Window position in physical pixels. Written by vacs.

selected_client_page_config.description: Name of the client page config selected on the Mission page.

signaling_auto_reconnect.description: Whether the client reconnects on its own after losing the server connection.

size.description: Window size in physical pixels. Written by vacs.

size_is_content.description:
Whether `size` measures the content area rather than the GTK window including its
client-side decorations. On Wayland, a size without this flag is discarded on restore.

split_profile_widths.description: Width of the profile pane in split view, in pixels, per profile. Set by dragging the divider.

test_profile_watcher_delay_ms.description:
Debounce delay before a changed test profile is reloaded, in milliseconds. `0`
disables reloading on change.

transmit_config.description: Call microphone mode and its bindings.

ClientGroupMode.description: Mode for controlling how DA keys are grouped on the Client page.

oneOf.description: Group by the first two letters (FIR) of the display name.
Group by the first four letters (ICAO code) of the display name.
First, group by the first two letters (FIR), then by the first four letters (ICAO code) of the display name.

ClientId.description: Unique identifier for a VATSIM client (CID).

ClientPageConfig.description: Configuration for the Client page, displaying all currently connected clients.

exclude.description:
Optional list of callsign patterns to exclude.

- Clients matching any pattern here are never shown, even if they match an `include` rule.

Glob syntax is supported: `"LO*"`, `"LOWW_*"`, `"*_APP"`, …
Matching is case-insensitive.

Example:
  `["*_TWR", "*_GND", "*_DEL"]`

frequencies.description:
Control how frequencies are displayed on the DA keys.

- `ShowAll`: Show frequency for all clients (default).
- `HideAll`: Never show frequencies.

grouping.description:
Control how DA keys are grouped.

- `None`: Don't group.
- `Fir`: Group by the first two letters (FIR) of the display name.
- `FirAndIcao`: First, group by the first two letters (FIR), then by the first four letters
  (ICAO code) of the display name (default).
- `Icao`: Group by the first four letters (ICAO code) of the display name.

include.description:
Optional list of callsign patterns to include.

- If this list is empty, all clients are eligible to be shown (subject to `exclude`).
- If this list is not empty, only clients matching at least one pattern are eligible to be shown.

Glob syntax is supported: `"LO*"`, `"LOWW_*"`, `"*_APP"`, …
Matching is case-insensitive.

Example:
  `["LO*", "EDDM_*", "EDMM_*"]`

priority.description:
Optional ordered list of callsign patterns used to assign priority.

The *first* matching pattern in the list determines the client's
priority bucket. Earlier entries = higher priority.

Glob syntax is supported: `"LO*"`, `"LOWW_*"`, `"*_APP"`, …
Matching is case-insensitive.

Example:
  `["LOVV_*", "LOWW_*_APP", "LOWW_*_TWR", "LOWW_*"]`

configs.description:
Named configs for different client page configurations.
Users can switch between configs in the UI.

oneOf.description: The day of the month instead of seconds.
CPL toggles couple mode, in which frequencies are coupled one by one.
CPL couples all transmitting frequencies at once.

FrequencyDisplayMode.description: Mode for controlling how frequencies are displayed on DA keys of the Client page.

oneOf.description: Always show frequencies for all clients.

InputCode.description: A keyboard key or a joystick button.

anyOf.description: A keyboard key code, for example "KeyA" or "ControlRight".

JoystickButton.description:
A joystick/gamepad button, addressed by stable device identity.

Devices are identified by their SDL joystick GUID (derived from bus/VID/PID),
which is stable across reconnects and USB ports - unlike SDL instance ids,
which change on every reconnect and thus cannot be persisted. Two physically
identical devices share a GUID, so a binding matches either of them; distinct
products (yoke, throttle, pedals) always have distinct GUIDs.

button.description: Raw button index on the device (SDL joystick button numbering).

device.description: SDL joystick GUID as a hex string.

JoystickDevice.description:
A joystick/gamepad device, addressed by its stable SDL GUID.

Used for the capture ignore list: devices with latched switches or
position-simulated buttons (common on flight sim throttles) would instantly
"capture" during binding, so users can exclude them. The GUID keeps the
entry valid across unplugs; `name` is retained for display while the device
is disconnected. Physically identical devices share a GUID and are ignored
together.

device.description: SDL joystick GUID as a hex string.

KeybindsConfig.description:
Configuration for generic call and playback control keybinds.

These keybinds allow accepting and ending calls, toggling radio prio and replaying the last
radio transmission without needing to use the UI and can be used independently of the transmit
mode.

accept_call.description: Input binding to accept an incoming call.

end_call.description: Input binding to end an active call.

say_again.description: Input binding to start or stop the SAY AGAIN replay.

toggle_radio_prio.description: Input binding to toggle radio prio during an active call.

enabled.description: Whether incoming radio transmissions are recorded for playback.

hangover_ms.description: Silence after a transmission before its recording is closed, in milliseconds.

max_clip_duration_s.description: Longest single recording, in seconds. A longer transmission continues in a new one.

PositionId.description: Unique identifier for a VATSIM position.

integration.description: Radio client vacs controls. Unset disables the integration.

RemoteConfig.description: Configuration for the embedded remote-control server.

enabled.description: Whether the remote control server is enabled.

listen_addr.description:
Socket address to bind the remote control server to.
Must be in the format "IP:PORT", e.g. "0.0.0.0:9600".

serve_frontend.description:
Whether to serve the web frontend. When disabled, only the WebSocket
API is exposed (useful for custom or third-party clients).

endpoint.description: Address of the TrackAudio SDK. Unset uses TrackAudio's default.

TransmitConfig.description: Configuration for the transmission mode and associated keybinds.

push_to_mute.description:
Input binding for Push-to-Mute mode.
Required if mode is `PushToMute`.

push_to_talk.description:
Input binding for Push-to-Talk mode.
Required if mode is `PushToTalk`.
